name: Electrocosto
description: Spanish online appliance store selling large and small appliances, air conditioning and heating, TVs, computing and phones, including refurbished and outlet items. Its delivery page states coverage of the Peninsula, Balearic Islands, Canary Islands, Ceuta and Melilla.
description_es: Tienda online española de electrodomésticos grandes y pequeños, climatización, televisores, informática y telefonía, con artículos reacondicionados y outlet. Su página de entrega indica cobertura en Península, Baleares, Canarias, Ceuta y Melilla.

ships_to.notes: Delivery page states coverage of the Peninsula, Balearic Islands, Canary Islands, Ceuta and Melilla. Free shipping to the Peninsula is advertised on the home page.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: The delivery page says pickup is available but does not describe where; treated as unknown.

shopping_notes: Large appliances use special transport with optional installation and removal of the old appliance; small items ship by parcel service.

sources.supports: product range, brands and free shipping to the Peninsula
delivery coverage and special transport services
